The ''' Special Operations Brigade Headquarters''' or '''Special Operations Brigade HQ ''', was stationed in the [[Arca Company Barracks]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was the base of operations for the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]].<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
